name: io.github.kylastech/kylas-crm
title: Kylas CRM
description: MCP server for Kylas CRM: create, search, and manage leads. Requires KYLAS_API_KEY or Kylas OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: KYLAS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Kylas API key (optional if using OAuth)

environmentVariables.name: KYLAS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Kylas API base URL (optional, default: https://api.kylas.io/v1)

environmentVariables.name: KYLAS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kylas Marketplace App Client ID (required for OAuth)

environmentVariables.name: KYLAS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Kylas Marketplace App Client Secret (required for OAuth)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SERVER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL of this MCP server (required for OAuth redirects)
